analyst.summary: Gabriel India makes shock absorbers and suspension parts, and has built a dominant 57% market share in electric two-wheelers -- a strong position in one of the fastest-growing parts of the Indian auto industry. The most recent quarter showed strong sales growth, but profit margins narrowed even as sales rose, which the market read negatively given how richly the stock is already priced. We rate it a Hold: a well-positioned business in the EV supply chain, but the price already assumes a lot of future success and near-term margins need to catch up.
